title: Majority Element II
summary: Return every distinct number that appears strictly more than one third of the time.
statement: Return every distinct number that appears strictly more than one third of the time. Output order is unrestricted.

examples.explanation: Both 1 and 2 occur twice in five positions.

hints: Conceptual: At most two values can cross the threshold.
Directional: Cancel groups of three different values, keeping two candidate slots.
Implementation: Verify the candidate frequencies in a second pass before returning them.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space for two-candidate voting.
